criteria.requirement: Implement werkzeug.problem_middleware.ProblemMiddleware(app) composing completed problem_response and optional validated werkzeug.request_id context. Convert only HTTPException raised during app call before successful start_response into actual problem JSON, retaining original status/protocol headers and request_id extension. Other Python exceptions, HTTPException after headers started and all iterable-time errors must propagate without sending a second response. Return success iterable unchanged. Verify the real stack RequestIdMiddleware(ProblemMiddleware(app)) with bounded strict JSON input: errors and successful negotiated responses share exact request ID and native close behavior.
